children.text: The purpose of the student council is to give students an opportunity to develop leadership by organizing and carrying out school activities and service projects. In addition to planning events that contribute to school spirit and community welfare, the student council is the voice of the student body. Student council leadership qualities consist of leadership, communication, humility, and responsibility.

children.text: The roles and expectations of house captains include, but are not limited to, the following:
Polite and well-mannered
Organized and committed
Well presented in uniform and appearance
Able to liaise and converse with staff, students, and the wider community
Desire to act responsibly and to be a role model for other students
Will have their photos posted on social media
Captains embody the 3 C’s in leading their teams: caring, courageous, and consistent.

children.text: At SAIS - Abu Dhabi, we emphasize holistic development, integrating academic excellence with character education, innovation, arts, athletics, and leadership programs.

Students benefit from well-equipped facilities, hands-on learning experiences, and access to Advanced Placement (AP) courses, STEM and robotics initiatives, and extracurricular activities that nurture their talents and critical thinking skills.

heading.title: Building Bright Futures with Purpose and Principle

children.text: We take great pride in our accomplished alumni, many of whom have been accepted into top-tier universities around the world and have gone on to become successful professionals, entrepreneurs, and leaders.
Our dedicated faculty comprises qualified and passionate educators committed to student growth, continuous professional development, and fostering a supportive and inclusive learning environment.
Together, the SAIS - Abu Dhabi community works to empower students to become lifelong learners, responsible global citizens, and leaders of tomorrow.

children.text: At SAIS - Abu Dhabi, we believe that education is more than academics; it’s about nurturing confident, capable, and compassionate individuals who are ready to thrive in a rapidly changing world.

Our journey began in 2016, and in a short time, we have become one of the most respected American-curriculum schools in the region. Backed by the legacy of the Sharjah American International School (established in 1997), our Abu Dhabi campus reflects a rich tradition of academic excellence, innovation, and strong values.
